SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE_CALL_EPOCH.des:
In a world far away, torn by portals to other dimensions, a lone youth stares intensely at one of them.

A voice beckons them to come closer.
The portal looks [red]unstable[/red]. There might not be a way back...

And yet, the youth steps forward.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_THE_CALL_EPOCH.unl: {IsRevealed:Played|Play} a run with the [green]Silent[/green]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
[purple]Shion, the Bruiser of a world far away[/purple] answered your call.
Unlocked [purple]The Bruiser[/purple] as a playable character.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_NEW_CHALLENGES_EPO:
[sine][blue]"go.... defeat the architect...."[/blue][/sine]

Now with an objective in mind and a boon in hand, the doubtful [purple]Shion[/purple] starts her ascension of [gold]The Spire[/gold].
Many a foes and traps are on her path. She was never the kind to think before acting. But if she had one thing going for her...

[purple]"It's my resilience!"[/purple]

Standing up to her foes again, the lone Bruiser makes for a reassuring sight.
Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] with [purple]Shion[/purple]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_MEMORIES_EPOCH.des:
Defeat. A familiar feeling.

As her consciousness fades, and her vision blurs, painful memories come back to haunt her.
Pain. Misery. Death. [red]And worse.[/red]

She wakes at the ground floor. The whale greets her and introduces itself again.

But she [b]remembers.[/b]
Shion meets with a [green]huntress[/green] during her ascension.

She isn't much for words. But the two get along reasonably fine.
The huntress takes a liking to the enthusiastic youth, and together, they rise anew, sharing some tricks along the way.

[purple]("It's nice not being alone... I almost forgot....")[/purple]
Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] with [purple]Shion[/purple]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_DETERMINATION_EPOC:
[purple]"RAAAAAGH!"[/purple]

With a powerful strike, the beast is fell.
Shion turns her gaze back to [green]her taciturn companion[/green], her earnest smile clashing with the blood on her clothes.

[purple]"Did you see that? Wasn't I cool?"[/purple]

Her new friend doesn't answer. Her eyes are covered. Yet, her disgust is seeable plenty.
Shion sighs, shaking her head. Maybe they weren't that akin, after all.

Weak as she was, she was resilient. But most of all, [jitter]determined[/jitter].
She wouldn't die until she proved to herself she wasn't [jitter]weak.[/jitter]
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_FAMILIAR_SCENE_EPO:
[purple]Defeat. Once more.
Nothing new or particularly heartbreaking, eh? We have always been the kind to falter in the face of adversity.

What's one more bow towards a powerful opponent gonna do?

No. It won't do.
You want it, don't you? You crave for it.

To bathe in the victory, hard earned, on your lonesome.
You know all too well friendship and weapons are temporary and frail. Only one's power matters.

When you next see the whale, make sure to tell her, with all of our heart...[/purple]

[red][jitter]"I will... I WILL KILL HIM...!!"[/jitter][/red]
Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] with [purple]Shion[/purple]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_TASTE_OF_POWER_EPO:
[sine]Feel....[/sine]

[purple][sine]Body and mind, as one.
The world around you's pulse, like a beating organ. Its heart is yours. We are one.

A fighter. A friend. A fury.

Choose not. Be all.

The future is yours to grasp.[/sine][/purple]

One gem brings forth a warrior's most powerful instincts.
{IsRevealed:Won|Win} a run with the [purple]Purple Chaos Emerald[/purple] as [purple]Shion[/purple]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SHION_IF_ONE_DOESNT_CUT_:
The magic of the [red]Architect[/red] strikes Shion's body.
The thunder fries her nervous system, the fire burns her skin clean off, and the sheer magical power knocks her out... almost.

Although she gave it her all, using her knowledge and her friend's, they both lied on the groun-
The [green]huntress[/green]...?
Where... [sine]she was gone...?![/sine]

The magic that healed Shion before whisked the huntress away during her last breath. Shion could feel it'd take her soon as well.

She closes her eyes in defeat.
Her heart yells at her to get up and continue the fight, survival be damned. But it was not to be.

Whether it was in number of friends, or Emeralds, [i]one[/i] wouldn't cut it.
{IsRevealed:Won|Win} a run on [gold]Ascension[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] with [purple]Shion[/purple]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THE_FACTORY_EPOCH.d:
A single [aqua]droplet[/aqua] of [sine]unknown substance[/sine] runs down an unsteady steel pipe. A familiar and stale journey. Gravity pulls. The ground comes close.

But this time, a [pink]softer[/pink] surface cushions the fall. A terrified [jitter]shout[/jitter] is followed by a [i]powerful slap[/i]. The [aqua]droplet[/aqua] goes [i][sine]flying[/sine][/i].

It [jitter]lands[/jitter], still intact. And it remembers. It met something [pink]alive[/pink]. [sine][i]Now it knows what it wants to be[/i][/sine].
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_THE_FACTORY_EPOCH.u: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] with [gold]Slal[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_REJECTIONS_EPOCH.de:
[jitter]It is [red]trash[/red]. It is [red]dangerous[/red].[/jitter]

The [aqua]droplet[/aqua] grows by absorbing unwanted debris. It looks like a clean blob, a friendly toy. It silently befriends a [pink]child[/pink].

But the [pink]child[/pink] goes [green][sine]sick[/sine][/green]. It is [red]trash[/red]. [jitter]It is dangerous[/jitter]. The [pink]child[/pink] was fine before. It [red]must[/red] be [i]its[/i] fault.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_REJECTIONS_EPOCH.un: Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]3[/blue] with [gold]Slal[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_MIMICKERY_EPOCH.des:
It wanted to [sine]protect[/sine] that dying cat. But at dawn, the cat was gone. [i]And it became the cat.[/i]

No, it is just mimickery. It is not [jitter]alive[/jitter]. It does not need to eat to survive. And yet it keeps [sine]exploring[/sine], now on all fours, much faster.

It observes. It copies. It learns. Animals are [sine]fascinating[/sine], but its real goal is still so far.

[b]Humanity.[/b]
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_CREATIVE_SOUL_EPOCH:
[jitter]A dying young man in a hospital bed.[/jitter] Far from his family, from his friends.

But this [aqua]mysterious visitor[/aqua] came to see him. To listen. So he shared with him all his [blue]projects[/blue], his [red]passions[/red], his [gold]creative spirit[/gold]. In the end, better share them with one stranger than [jitter]no-one at all[/jitter].

He lived hours longer than expected, but his final breath came. The [aqua]visitor[/aqua] embraced him.

The next morning, the man left through the window. [sine]Unscathed.[/sine]
{IsRevealed:Won|Win} a run on [gold]Ascension[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] with [gold]Slal[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_INFINITE_WORLDS_EPO:
A [orange]paradise[/orange] for anyone, from anywhere. Built with [red][sine]passion[/sine][/red], [i][aqua]spirit[/aqua][/i], and a whole lot of [b][rainbow]Random Energy[/rainbow][/b].

It worked! [green]Stories[/green] are woven here. [orange]Friendships[/orange] bloom. Through trials and tribulations, [i]impossible things become true[/i].

He did it. He found [pink]love[/pink], and a [orange]family[/orange]. [i]He just had to forget what he truly is.[/i]

[i]What [red][jitter]it[/jitter][/red] truly is[/i].
Beat [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] with [gold]Slal[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_SELF_DISCOVERY_EPOC:
It is a [red]slime[/red]. A tool made to clean up trash and then be destroyed. It [jitter]fled[/jitter], [sine]changed[/sine], tried to [color=gray]forget[/color].

[sine]It looked like it was working.[/sine]

A [purple]shapeshifter[/purple] from another world showed him his true self. It is a [aqua]slime[/aqua]. She knew. [b]They are still friends.[/b] It is still a he.

[i]But he can no longer pretend he is human.[/i]
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_RECONNAISSANCE_EPOC:
That big [blue]tower[/blue] looks promising. Cool places to explore, interesting people to meet.

Even [aqua]fellow slimes[/aqua]! Not very talkative though.

He was told there is an [blue]Architect[/blue] up there. Wearing a mask, creating new stuff, running the place.

They have [i]so much[/i] in common. A future [aqua]friend[/aqua] for sure.
{IsRevealed:Played|Play} a run with [purple]Shion[/purple]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_MISTAKE_EPOCH.title: Mistake
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_MISTAKE_EPOCH.descr:
These [aqua]precious gems[/aqua]. They should not be here.

It is probably his fault. [sine]It generally is.[/sine]

He needs to fix this. Those emeralds share their power to whoever completes their challenge.

He can do that. By accident. He can do many, many, [red]impossible[/red] things by accident.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-SLAL_MISTAKE_EPOCH.unloc: {IsRevealed:Unlocked|Unlock} the [aqua]Cyan Chaos Emerald[/aqua]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this Epoch}.
